summary: VBIE iteration 32 (live real buyer ingestion + paywall) tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass on /api/buyers/* including meta (total=257 real), search filters (country/sector/corridor/hs/trust_min/q, sorted by trust desc), sources registry (11 sources, sanctions_screening.denied_parties>1000), paywall on GET /{geid} (locked=true, lock_reason='login', website hidden, provenance=[]) and 402 on /{geid}/evidence unauth, admin token gating (401 without header, 200 with X-Admin-Token), POST /buyers/ingest/run returns ok, screened_out>=1 in last run (1 blocked), no fake demo names remain, all buyers sample=false. Backend scheduler log confirms 'VBIE daily ingestion scheduler started (02:00 UTC)' and startup ingestion 'upserted=257 screened_out=1 real_total=257 samples_removed=12'. Frontend: /buyers loads with 257 result-count (not stuck on Searching…), all filter/search testids present, home page has nav-link-verified-buyers + home-verified-buyers section + home-buyers-cta, buyer profile /buyers/:geid unauthenticated shows buyer-profile-header + buyer-paywall + paywall-signin (paywall-plan is conditional on being signed-in-without-plan, so absent when logged out — expected), buyer-claim-btn opens buyer-claim-modal and lead submission returns 'Request received' confirmation (not gated).

issues: Cookie consent banner overlays bottom of viewport and can intercept clicks on lower buyer cards — did not affect core flows but consider raising card z-index or auto-hiding banner after first dismissal.

critical_code_review_comments: paywall-plan testid is only rendered for signed-in users without an active plan; unauth users see paywall-signin only. This is correct but worth documenting in the testid contract so future tests don't flag it as missing.

Old test file /app/backend/tests/test_vbie_buyers.py hardcodes total==12 and non-paywalled detail/evidence — it is now obsolete and will fail if executed. Recommend deleting or superseding with test_vbie_live_buyers.py.

Search query 'rice' returned 0 results despite 257 EU TED buyers — text search may not index all buyer fields (e.g., titles). Not a bug, but noting: consider indexing display_name+sector+products for q.
